sentences.text_target: Tom and his partner arrive at the restaurant.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ænd hɪz ˈpɑːtnər əˈraɪv æt ðə ˈrɛstrɒnt./
sentences.text_native: Tom et sa partenaire arrivent au restaurant.

sentences.text_target: They want to reserve a nice table.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɒnt tuː rɪˈzɜːv ə naɪs ˈteɪbl./
sentences.text_native: Ils veulent réserver une jolie table.

sentences.text_target: The man says his name to the person at the door.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə mæn sɛz hɪz neɪm tuː ðə ˈpɜːsn æt ðə dɔː./
sentences.text_native: L'homme donne son nom à la personne à l'entrée.

sentences.text_target: It is a cold evening outside.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə kəʊld ˈiːvnɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
sentences.text_native: C'est une soirée froide dehors.

sentences.text_target: A friendly waiter greets them with a smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈfrɛndli ˈweɪtə griːts ðɛm wɪð ə smaɪl./
sentences.text_native: Un serveur sympathique les accueille avec le sourire.

sentences.text_target: He helps them take off their heavy coats.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː hɛlps ðɛm teɪk ɒf ðɛər ˈhɛvi kəʊts./
sentences.text_native: Il les aide à retirer leurs manteaux d'hiver.

sentences.text_target: The staff hangs the coats near the entrance.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə stɑːf hæŋz ðə kəʊts nɪə ðə ˈɛntrəns./
sentences.text_native: Le personnel accroche les manteaux près de l'entrée.

sentences.text_target: They walk to a table near the window.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɔːk tuː ə ˈteɪbl nɪə ðə ˈwɪndəʊ./
sentences.text_native: Ils s'avancent vers une table près de la fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: The two friends sit on comfortable chairs.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə tuː frɛndz sɪt ɒn ˈkʌmfətəbl tʃɛəz./
sentences.text_native: Les deux amis s'asseyent sur des chaises confortables.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks at the clean white cloth on the table.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm lʊks æt ðə kliːn waɪt klɒθ ɒn ðə ˈteɪbl./
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde la belle nappe blanche sur la table.

sentences.text_target: They open the big menu to read the choices.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈəʊpən ðə bɪg ˈmɛnjuː tuː riːd ðə ˈtʃɔɪsɪz./
sentences.text_native: Ils ouvrent le grand menu pour découvrir les choix.

sentences.text_target: The waiter brings cold water in a glass bottle.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈweɪtə brɪŋz kəʊld ˈwɔːtər ɪn ə glɑːs ˈbɒtl./
sentences.text_native: Le serveur apporte de l'eau fraîche dans une bouteille en verre.

sentences.text_target: He pours fresh water into small glasses.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pɔːz frɛʃ ˈwɔːtər ˈɪntuː smɔːl ˈglɑːsɪz./
sentences.text_native: Il verse de l'eau fraîche dans de petits verres.

sentences.text_target: Tom is very hungry and wants a hot soup.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋgri ænd wɒnts ə hɒt suːp./
sentences.text_native: Tom a très faim et veut une soupe chaude.

sentences.text_target: His friend chooses a fresh tomato salad.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz frɛnd ˈtʃuːzɪz ə frɛʃ təˈmɑːtəʊ ˈsæləd./
sentences.text_native: Son amie choisit une salade de tomates fraîche.

sentences.text_target: They also share some bread with fresh butter.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ ʃeə sʌm brɛd wɪð frɛʃ ˈbʌtə./
sentences.text_native: Ils partagent aussi du pain avec du beurre frais.

sentences.text_target: After a short minute, the waiter takes the first plates.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ə ʃɔːt ˈmɪnɪt, ðə ˈweɪtə teɪks ðə fɜːst pleɪts./
sentences.text_native: Quelques instants plus tard, le serveur apporte les entrées.

sentences.text_target: The soup smells delicious and very good.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə suːp smɛlz dɪˈlɪʃəs ænd ˈvɛri gʊd./
sentences.text_native: La soupe sent délicieusement bon.

sentences.text_target: Next, they order the main course for dinner.
sentences.phonetic: /nɛkst, ðeɪ ˈɔːdə ðə meɪn kɔːs fɔː ˈdɪnə./
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, ils commandent le plat principal.

sentences.text_target: Tom wants chicken with rice and vegetables.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm wɒnts ˈtʃɪkɪn wɪð raɪs ænd ˈvɛdʒtəblz./
sentences.text_native: Tom choisit du poulet avec du riz et des légumes.

sentences.text_target: His friend prefers fish with hot potatoes.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz frɛnd prɪˈfɜːz fɪʃ wɪð hɒt pəˈteɪtəʊz./
sentences.text_native: Son amie préfère du poisson avec des pommes de terre chaudes.

sentences.text_target: They add a little salt and pepper to the food.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ æd ə ˈlɪtl sɔːlt ænd ˈpɛpə tuː ðə fuːd./
sentences.text_native: Ils ajoutent un peu de sel et de poivre à leur plat.

sentences.text_target: They taste the meal and speak happily.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ teɪst ðə miːl ænd spiːk ˈhæpɪli./
sentences.text_native: Ils goûtent le repas et discutent joyeusement.

sentences.text_target: The food is warm and tastes fantastic.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fuːd ɪz wɔːm ænd teɪsts fænˈtæstɪk./
sentences.text_native: Le plat est chaud et a un goût fantastique.

sentences.text_target: After eating, they look at the dessert menu.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ˈiːtɪŋ, ðeɪ lʊk æt ðə dɪˈzɜːt ˈmɛnjuː./
sentences.text_native: Après avoir mangé, ils regardent la carte des desserts.

sentences.text_target: Tom orders a sweet chocolate cake.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈɔːdəz ə swiːt ˈtʃɒklɪt keɪk./
sentences.text_native: Tom commande un gâteau au chocolat.

sentences.text_target: When they finish, Tom asks to pay the bill.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn ðeɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ, tɒm ɑːsks tuː peɪ ðə bɪl./
sentences.text_native: Une fois le repas terminé, Tom demande l'addition.

sentences.text_target: He takes out his bank card to pay the money.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː teɪks aʊt hɪz bæŋk kɑːd tuː peɪ ˈʌp./
sentences.text_native: Il sort sa carte bancaire pour régler.

sentences.text_target: They thank the nice waiter and say goodbye.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ θæŋk ðə naɪs ˈweɪtə ænd seɪ gʊdˈbaɪ./
sentences.text_native: Ils remercient le charmant serveur et lui disent au revoir.

sentences.text_target: Then they walk out of the restaurant door.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn ðeɪ wɔːk aʊt ɒv ðə ˈrɛstrɒnt dɔː./
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, ils franchissent la porte du restaurant pour sortir.
